simple.summary: שָׁחַק (shâchaq) means to comminate (by trituration or attrition) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 22 43.

definitions.full: H7833. shachaq [ שָׁחַק ] verb rub away, beat fine, pulverize (so Arabic , worn garment, thin clouds ; Aramaic שְׁחַק , pilverize ; Ecclus שחק Ecclesiasticus 6:36 is go often (wear by treading), Str compare iter terere ); — Qal Perfect 3plural מַיִם שָֽׁחֲקוּ אֲבָּנִים Job 14:19 waters rub away stones ; 2 masculine singular וְשָׁחַקְתָּ֫ Exod 30:36 (P; of pulverizing incense, see דקק Hiph`il ); figurative, accusative of foes, Imperfect 1singular suffix וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם 2Sam 22:43 (||) = Psa 18:43 .
